name: Sagawa Wataru
source:
A company employee in his fourth year of business.
He is the same age as his wife Rumi.
He is a serious and hardworking person, though he is not very capable, and the company trusts him and has begun to entrust him with large jobs.
He loves his wife, Rumi, and is grateful for the housework she usually does for him.
He has wanted her to have some free time for herself for a long time,
I had no intention of opposing Rumi's wish to go out to work,
However, he is concerned about Rumi's natural disposition.
